artcraft-launcher.tagline: Installs and updates the Craft App Suite
artcraft-launcher.notes:
## Added
- ArtCraft Launcher 0.9.3, built from the original release [v0.9.0](https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/releases/tag/v0.9.0) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.9.0 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---

### Original release notes

## What's Changed
* Migrate Craft Launcher to egui 0.37 by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/873
* refactor: delegate self-update functionality to craft-update by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/871
* build: pin craft-update to craft-libs main (495e597) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/896

* native(install): split the archive unpack and the flat-layout move into helpers (S3776) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/903

* Enforce Rust coding standards via Clippy by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/927
* Windows installation policy: ArtCraft Launcher by @Jeremy8776 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/pull/925


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher/compare/v0.8.1...v0.9.0
